author: OhLookItsDaOne
description: Manage Discord AutoMod rules via simple commands: list, enable, disable rules and manage allow lists (up to 100 entries) with a configurable default rule.
install_msg: Cog installed. Use `[p]automod` to manage AutoMod rules and `[p]siteallow` to manage the allow list.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild configuration (allowed roles, rule shortname mappings, allow list and default rule). No end user data is stored.
